text:
maya: Heads up — noticed a burst of client reconnects on EU stream edges ~08:40 UTC. Appears to correlate with a keepalive probe change rolled yesterday. Some clients show immediate 204 and then reconnect loop.

sam: Ugh. Are these SSE or WS?

maya: SSE. Our proxy started returning 204 for idle probes if the route had >50% fanout. Previously it held a 2s pingback. Now clients think stream closed.

eli: Can you paste a sample of the proxy response?

maya: Sure — here's an example from edge logs:

```
GET /v1/stream/abc/resume 200
X-Stream-Event: keepalive\nContent-Length: 0\n
--- proxied -> backend returned 204 for probe
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content\nConnection: keep-alive\n```

maya: Clients treat 204 as terminal and re-establish. Then our quota-metering sees multiple new sessions and double-charges.

ops-bot: Incident flagged: reconnect-surge-eu-08:40. Notified eng-oncall.

sam: That double-charge is the worst. Where is the semantics leak? 204 should be indistinguishable from an empty keepalive frame, right?

eli: Historically we used SSE comment `:keepalive\n\n` frames. Proxy change treats probe as full response. We need to normalize in the proxy or make client tolerant.

jess: UX question — console currently shows "session terminated" when last_event_id missing + 204. We could tweak wording to "probing - resuming" to reduce ops noise while we fix.

maya: Proposal: patch proxy to map 204 -> 200 with SSE comment body for in-flight probes. Short-term fix. Longer-term: add per-route probe sampling metric and a "keepalive-interpretation" flag in routing policy so controlled rollouts don't change semantics.

eli: Agreed. Also need to update quota-metering so transient reconnects within a 5s window dedupe per client-id/token. Otherwise billing war.

sam: Can we do a canary of the proxy change in eu-west-1 only? I want telemetry to show reconnection count, billing spikes, and console alerts.

maya: Yes. Canary plan: 1% traffic -> 10% -> 100% with automatic rollback on reconnection-rate > 5x baseline. Add metrics: `stream.reconnect.rate`, `stream.reconnect.duplicate_billing`, `proxy.probe.204_count`.

jess: I'll add temporary console panels: one for reconnect.rate by route, one for charge-delta. Also add a lightweight annotation in rollout UI to mark whether keepalive semantics changed.

eli: Patching quota logic pseudo-config:

```
{"quota_dedupe_window_ms": 5000, "dedupe_by": ["token","client_id"], "probe_to_keepalive": true}
```

eli: If `probe_to_keepalive` true, proxy converts 204->200 SSE comment.

maya: @oncall-bot can you attach the incident runbook and add a playbook step to mute console "session terminated" alerts for the affected routes during canary?

oncall-bot: Runbook attached. Muting alerts for routes: /v1/stream/*:eu-west-1 for 2h.

sam: One more thought — some clients (mobile SDKs) will still re-open on 204. We should ship a client-side tolerant patch that treats 204 as keepalive for next minor release and add a header `X-Stream-Probe: 1` so clients can opt-in to tolerant behavior.

maya: Good call. Sequence: (1) proxy mapping + dedupe quota server-side, (2) canary, (3) client patch + console messaging, (4) permanent routing policy flag and dashboard.

jess: I'll queue console panels + rollout annotation. ETA ~2h for dashboard.

eli: I'll open a PR for proxy mapping and quota dedupe. Tagging for review: @sam @maya.

maya: Thanks — let's aim for the canary at 10:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
